budget_categories.name: Venue & Rentals
budget_categories.rationale: Ceremony and reception space, chairs, tables, and setup fees.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Consider non-Saturday dates or off-peak seasons for reduced venue hire rates.

budget_categories.name: Catering & Bar
budget_categories.rationale: Meals, appetizers, service staff, bar service, and tableware.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Opt for buffet or family-style service rather than individual plated dinners.

budget_categories.name: Photography & Video
budget_categories.rationale: Full-day photo and video documentation of key ceremony and reception rituals.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Book 6 to 8 hours of coverage rather than full 12-hour packages.

budget_categories.name: Decor & Florals
budget_categories.rationale: Ceremony backdrop, table centerpieces, entryway arrangements, and lighting.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Repurpose ceremony floral arrangements as reception table centerpieces.

budget_categories.name: Music & Entertainment
budget_categories.rationale: DJ or live musicians for processional, dinner ambiance, and dance party.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Hire a solo acoustic artist for ceremony and a high-energy DJ for the reception.

budget_categories.name: Attire & Beauty
budget_categories.rationale: Wedding outfits, hair styling, makeup artist, and alterations.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Explore designer rental collections or trunk sales for ceremony attire.

budget_categories.name: Invitations & Stationery
budget_categories.rationale: Save-the-dates, formal invitations, menus, and program cards.
budget_categories.saving_tip: Send digital save-the-dates and print only reception paper goods.

vendor_categories.title: Ceremony & Reception Venue
questions_to_ask: What is the exact maximum guest capacity for seated dining?
Are there noise curfews or amplified music limitations?
What is the cancellation and inclement weather backup policy?
documents_to_verify: Itemized facility contract and security deposit schedule
red_flags: Refusal to provide written itemization of hidden cleaning or service fees
No clear backup space for outdoor ceremony areas
Lack of designated commercial catering prep area

vendor_categories.title: Catering & Beverage Provider
questions_to_ask: Can you accommodate specific dietary, religious, and allergy requirements?
What is your ratio of servers and bartenders per guest count?
Is food prepared on-site or transported from a commissary kitchen?
documents_to_verify: Liquor license and liquor liability insurance
Full tasting agreement with dish specifications
red_flags: Unwillingness to conduct a pre-event menu tasting
Vague answers regarding handling surplus food and cleanup duties

vendor_categories.title: Lead Photographer & Videographer
questions_to_ask: Have you worked at our venue or similar lighting conditions before?
What is your backup plan if the primary shooter falls ill on event day?
What is the exact turnaround time and delivery format for final galleries?
documents_to_verify: Standard photography service agreement with rights of use
Sample complete full-day wedding gallery (not just portfolio highlights)
red_flags: Contract does not guarantee the specific lead photographer you interviewed
No dual-card backup cameras during shooting
Turnaround times exceeding 12 weeks without justification

vendor_categories.title: Florist & Decor Designer
questions_to_ask: Do you handle setup, teardown, and end-of-night disposal?
What seasonal bloom substitutions do you propose if shortages occur?
Can you provide digital design mockups or sample centerpiece boards?
documents_to_verify: Itemized floral recipe and rental inventory manifest
Liability insurance for venue rigging and candle usage
red_flags: No late-night teardown crew included, leaving cleanup to client
Demands full cash payment upfront without written milestones
